ai_assistant-ai-permission-always-allow-: Give the Agent full autonomy — no manual approval ever required.
ai_assistant-ai-permission-always-ask-de: Require explicit approval before the Agent takes any action.
ai_assistant-ai-permission-ask-on-first-: The agent will ask for permission the first time it needs to interact with a running command. After that, it will continue automatically for the rest of that command.
ai_assistant-ai-permission-write-always-: The agent will always ask for permission to interact with a running command.
ai_assistant-ai-permission-computer-use-: Computer use tools are disabled and will not be available to the Agent.
Require explicit approval before the Agent uses computer use tools.
Give the Agent full autonomy to use computer use tools without approval.
ai_assistant-ai-permission-ask-except-au: The Agent may ask a question and pause for your response, but will continue automatically when auto-approve is on.
ai_assistant-ai-permission-never-ask-des: The Agent will not ask questions and will continue with its best judgment.
ai_assistant-ai-permission-always-ask-qu: The Agent may ask a question and will pause for your response even when auto-approve is on.
